env._comment: V6 guard enforcement modes (audit Phase 3, 2026-06-09). Read by scripts/state/{secret,exec,state}_guard.py via EMPIRE_HOOK_* (enforce|report|off). Tracked here so all machines inherit; VPS daemons also read these keys from .env.agents.
env._comment_v6_mode: V6 staged cutover (2026-07-18): shadow = state_sync dual-writes flat files + the state DB. Shadow NEVER runs the `on`-mode export, so flat files stay authoritative and nothing is clobbered — a safe soak before any future `on` flip. Read by scripts/state/state_sync.py. Daemons inherit the same value from ecosystem.config.js on their next PM2 restart.
